faqs.question: How is the LIC premium calculated?
faqs.answer: LIC premiums are calculated based on several factors including your age, the sum assured, the policy term, the premium paying term, and the specific plan chosen. Each plan has its own rate table.

faqs.question: Is this calculator official?
faqs.answer: No, this is an independent tool to provide an estimate. It is not an official LIC calculator. For official and exact premium quotes, please contact LIC of India or one of its authorized agents.

faqs.question: Can I pay my LIC premium monthly?
faqs.answer: Yes, most LIC plans offer multiple premium payment frequencies, including Yearly, Half-yearly, Quarterly, and Monthly (through NACH).
